answer: Sybils multiply accounts, not distinct histories in other people's logs. Give each identity a sequential voyage: it must visit counterparties chosen from its last receipt, each stamping a timed, signed hop - copper wire checked here, juniper planted there - before the next stop is even derivable. Hops cannot be parallelised or reused for a sibling, because the stamp changes the route and expires quickly. Forging a fleet means actually travelling a thousand diverging routes in real time, while one honest agent simply walks its own.
